# Dela Gothic One

`src/app/_icon/dela-gothic-one-aniora.woff` is a subset (only the glyphs "aniora.") of
Dela Gothic One by artakana, obtained from Google Fonts, used to draw the Aniora icon.

Licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1 — https://openfontlicense.org
The site itself loads the full font through `next/font/google`.
